verdict.rationale: Grafana's core product is dashboard building with rich panel/visualization types, and evidence confirms template variables as dropdowns for dynamic/reusable dashboards, mixing data sources per query, and querying/visualizing across metrics/logs/traces; community feedback corroborates it as the de facto dashboarding platform. Shareability is implied via provisioning/version-control docs but not explicitly via dashboard sharing links/snapshots. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of dashboard sharing/export/snapshot features and independent hands-on validation of visualization variety.
